recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source edit is recommended unless MolecularSequence is reintroduced or a later Clinical Genomics decision changes the current single-resolvable-representation model.
issue_request: FHIR-37060 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics R5 technical correction asking that MolecularSequence.formatted be limited to one Attachment so only a single sequence representation is shared with a MolecularSequence resource. The final resolution was to update formatted cardinality to 0..1.
initial_application: Commit 087684e44393718e34bc9d91e0d254836098986a, "FHIR-37060 - fix cardinality of formatted attribute", changed source/molecularsequence/structuredefinition-MolecularSequence.xml from max="*" to max="1". The Jira comment also identifies HL7/fhir pull request 1921 as the implementation PR.
additional_context: Later Clinical Genomics work in FHIR-40567 renamed MolecularSequence.formatted to MolecularSequence.file, and the current build has retired the old MolecularSequence source: source/fhir.ini comments out molecularsequence and activates moleculardefinition, while source/molecularsequence has been deleted. The active source at source/moleculardefinition/structuredefinition-MolecularDefinition.xml defines MolecularDefinition.representation.resolvable with max="1".
reconciliation: No source change was made. The historical FHIR-37060 fix is already present in source history, and current build-scope source either lacks the obsolete MolecularSequence.formatted element or already preserves the single-cardinality behavior through MolecularDefinition.representation.resolvable.
